resources.string: Turn control on in Live, with the renderer connected, to use these on the LEDs.
HiLight lights each LED in turn and you tap where it is around the ring. After that, every effect, the compass and per-LED colours travel round the ring in the order you see on screen.
Not mapped yet: using the default order, which has not been confirmed on hardware.
LED %1$d of %2$d is lit white. Tap where it is.
The ring is drawn as seen looking at the back of the phone, top of the phone up. A mirror helps, or ask someone to look.
A comet is running round the ring. Did it travel smoothly, one LED to the next?
A %1$d-scene light show through the best effects, about %2$d seconds. Lay the phone screen-down and press play.
Put the phone screen-down in the middle of the table. Spin the wheel to pick who goes next, or roll a die: the pips light up around the ring.
Shake to roll (while this screen is open)

Play a song and press Listen. The ring finds the beat and dances along: a new colour every beat, a white flash on each bar, a new move every four beats, and brighter when the music gets louder. Up to five minutes at a time.
Hears whatever this phone is playing, at any volume. If Android won\'t share it, the microphone takes over.
Hears music from any speaker in the room.
Phone audio couldn\'t be read, so the microphone is listening instead.
Music sync needs the microphone permission to hear the music.
Music sync stopped. Press Listen to go again.
Couldn\'t start listening. Check the microphone permission for HiLight Studio in Settings.
Lay the phone screen-down and the LED pointing to magnetic north glows red, with a faint white tail opposite. Runs for one minute and keeps the screen awake.
This phone does not report a compass sensor.
The compass is unsure. Move the phone in a figure of eight to recalibrate it.

Map your LEDs above first and no calibration is needed. Otherwise, needle pointing the wrong way? Point the top of the phone north: the LED nearest the top edge should glow. If another does, turn the needle until it does. Then turn the phone clockwise; if the needle turns the same way, reverse it.
The ring fills as you breathe in, stays full while you hold, empties as you breathe out and rests dark. Lay the phone screen-down and follow the light.
In 4 s, hold 4 s, out 4 s, rest 4 s. Steady and focusing.
In 4 s, hold 7 s, out 8 s. Slow and relaxing, often used before sleep.
In 5 s, out 5 s, with a short rest. Simple and even.

Shake the phone firmly while the screen is on for a short burst of sparkles in a random colour. It listens only while the screen is on, through HiLight\'s background watcher, whose notification then shows. Quiet hours, Do Not Disturb and battery rules still apply.
Colours follow the time of day
Indigo at night, rose at dawn, sky blue in the morning, warm white at midday, gold and red at sunset, violet at dusk. Your own colours come back when you turn this off.
This effect has colours of its own, so time-of-day colours apply once you pick a one- or two-colour effect.
Listening for a shake while the screen is on
